title: Simultaneous primitive roots: a conditional lower bound for prime bases
summary: For every fixed finite set of distinct positive primes, we prove that at least $`cx/(\log x)^2`$ primes in $`(x,2x)`$ have every member of the set as a primitive root, for some c > 0 and all sufficiently large x . The result assumes four explicitly stated analytic and sieve inputs from the companion paper on primitive roots for admissible integer bases.
family_title: Primitive roots for every admissible integer base

review.reason: Conditional lower bound on primes having given bases as primitive roots.
